name: Mitotic Slime
description: An Ooze from Magic 2011 that splits into smaller Oozes when it dies; the columnist's favourite card of the set.

timeline.summary: The columnist reflects that Mitotic Slime is his favourite Magic 2011 card and enjoys playing it in the office league.
timeline.quote: Playing "The Slime" in the inter-office M11 league has been a delight as it is bursting with flavor.
